Toast

Introduction

Display a black translucent message is displayed in the middle of the page for notification, loading tips, and operation result display.

Sample Code

Text message

<maui-toast type="text" message=" text message " />

Loading message

Use the Toast.loading method to display a loading message, uses the forbidClick attribute to disable background clicking, and uses the loadingType attribute to customize the loading icon type.

<maui-toast type="loading" message="loading message" />

Success/Failure message

<maui-toast type = 'success' message='success message'/>
<maui-toast type = 'fail' message='failure message'/>

Dynamic update message

page({
    selectToast(e) {
        this.setData({
            currentType: e.currentTarget.dataset.type
        })
        if (e.currentTarget.dataset.type == "changing") {
            for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    this.setData({
                        loadingTime: 3 - i
                    })
                }, i * 1000);
            }
        }
        setTimeout(() => {
            this.setData({
                currentType: ""
            })
        }, this.data.duration);
    }
})

<maui-toast ma:if="{{currentType == 'changing'}}" type="loading" message="倒计时{{loadingTime}}秒" duration="{{duration}}" loadingType="spinner" />

API

Options

Attribute Description Type Default Value
type Message type. The options are loading, success, fail, and html. String text
message Content. String ''
mask Whether to display the mask layer. Boolean false
forbidClick Whether to forbid background clicking. Boolean false
loadingType Loading icon type. The value can be spinner. String circular
zIndex z-index level. Number 1000
duration Display duration, in milliseconds. Number 2000

Slot

Name Description
- Custom contents.
